title: feat: idempotency keys for the charge endpoint
body:
## What
Adds `Idempotency-Key` support to `POST /charges` so retried requests don't double-charge.

## Why
A network retry on the mobile client created duplicate charges (incident #229).

## How
- Store key -> response for 24h in Redis
- Replay the stored response on a repeat key

comments.body: What happens if two requests with the same key arrive concurrently?
